Player-menu post-response transition. AddTopicList is unconditional for a processed INFO. Only INFOGENERAL/D7 without RunForRumors skips Goodbye handling and RunResult; INFOGENERAL always rebuilds from player known topics instead of following INFO links. The 0x40 flag has no effect on ordinary topics.
